claim: Cost-math lane 1.2, wave 3 (QA round 4 on #780): every landed-cost line states whether its printed price holds the tax (price_tax_basis) and its rate (vat_rate_percent), and treatTax costs a reclaiming house's line BEFORE tax whichever way the paper prints it (ADR 0359 C3, Proposed).
